product_metadata.title: Lifter Hamper Spring Loaded Laundry Hamper, Black
features: Easy to move around the house with built-in wheels
No more bending over to pick up your clothes
The Lifter Hamper is a bungee spring loaded laundry hamper
Available in an assortment of colors
description: The Lifter Hamper is not your ordinary laundry hamper. This innovative laundry hamper's patented Lifter Liner allows it to drop down with the weight of the laundry and rise to the top as laundry is removed . The handle and wheels also make is easy to move from one room to another room, making that back breaking chore easy to do. The Lifter Hamper is stylish and comes in an assortment of colors with it's removable outer shell. Once you've tried the lifter hamper you'll never want to go back to your old laundry hamper.
